path.title: Serves published app files from [read-only mount]
Reads from and writes to [SQL, pgx pool]
Writes published app builds to [file system]
Stores and reads encrypted files in [S3 API]
Dumps and records runs in [pg_dump, SQL]
Loads the apps and calls /api through [HTTPS :443]

g.title: Staff app [Container: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind] Create Order, History, employees, catalogue, item sets, company assets, dashboards; public receipt confirmation page. At /
Administration [Container: React 19, TypeScript, Vite] Users, roles, settings, AI usage, mail templates, suppliers, app releases, backups, audit, security, system. At /admin/
App Launcher [Container: React 19, TypeScript, Vite] Tiles for every app the user's roles open; apps in testing for Testers. At /apps/
g.text: Tiles for every app the user's roles
open; apps in testing for Testers.

g.title: Scan SIMs [Container: React SPA, published app (device profile)] Registers batches of SIM cards with the phone camera. At /apps/sim-scan/
g.text: Registers batches of SIM cards with

g.title: Docs Import [Container: React SPA, published app (device profile)] Reads identity documents (MRZ) in the browser with the camera and crops portraits. At /apps/docs-import/
g.text: the browser with the camera and

g.title: Web server / reverse proxy [Container: Caddy 2.11] Terminates TLS; serves every SPA bundle and published-app file on one origin with cache headers and CSP; proxies /api, /health, /ready and published-app pages to the API.
g.text: bundle and published-app file on one
origin with cache headers and CSP;

g.title: API [Container: Go 1.27, net/http, muxstack, pgx] JSON API for every bounded context (modular monolith): auth and permissions, business rules, PDFs, sealing of sensitive data, audit, scheduled upkeep.
g.text: JSON API for every bounded context

g.title: Migration job [Container: psql, plain SQL migrations] Runs on every deploy: applies pending migrations and grants, then exits. The API starts only after it succeeds.
g.text: exits. The API starts only after it

g.title: Database [Container: PostgreSQL 18] Users, roles, sessions, employees, catalogue, orders, assets, sealed personnel files, audit log and seals, security events, backup runs.
Backup agent [Container: Go, remisb/dbbackup, pg_dump] Nightly dump (03:00), prune (14 days / last 7), optional encryption; records every run for the Backups screen.
g.text: records every run for the Backups

g.title: Published app store [Container: Docker volume] Immutable builds of published apps: <profile>/<slug>/<version>/.
Object storage [External System] DigitalOcean Spaces (S3 API), private buckets: signed copies, personnel document copies, off-site DB backups.
DigitalOcean Monitoring [External System] Uptime check on /ready plus droplet alerts; emails the operator.
OpenAI API [External System] Generates colour ID photos for Personnel files; validates the stored API key.
Timestamp authority [External System] Public RFC 3161 TSA (DigiCert by default); timestamps the hash of each day's audit seal.
Let's Encrypt [External System] Issues and renews TLS certificates (ACME).
